findings.text: North averages $113.32 per order while South averages $94.03, based on 24 orders total — this result is uncertain due to the small sample size.
A comparison test found the revenue gap between regions could be chance; the result did not clear the conventional threshold for confidence, so no firm conclusion can be drawn.
Across all orders, revenue ranges from $55.34 to $135.76 with a median of $98.65, indicating meaningful spread within the data.
